title: What Did You See? - Mit Láttál?
grammar: adjective + accusative object; choosing indefinite vs. definite past

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can describe what I bought or saw with an adjective, keeping the adjective bare and putting the case ending only on the noun.
I can choose indefinite or definite past endings correctly based on whether the object is specific.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can describe what I bought or saw with an adjective, keeping the adjective bare and putting the case ending only on the noun.
I can choose indefinite or definite past endings correctly based on whether the object is specific.
